content.content: Undo and redo are defined over whole deccy operations — creation, recording, removal: undoing a creation removes the created node entire; undoing a recording restores the prior file state; undoing a removal restores the node entire. Partial undo of an operation's internals is not undo.
content.rationale: D0 promises undo of operations without saying what an operation is for undo purposes; only whole-operation units match how mistakes happen — one wrong move, one undo — and only whole units keep every intermediate state a valid graph.
